name: dumbbell rear lunge to single arm shoulders press
description: A combo move: a rear lunge followed by a single-arm press as you stand. It works legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at one shoulder and stand tall.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to stand up.
As you rise, press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it to your shoulder and repeat.
Switch arms or legs each set.
